mentions.name: Modular patch documentation app
mentions.description: An application for documenting modular synth patches. It uses machine learning to recognize patch points, knobs, and toggles from a photo of a module's front panel, letting users build racks from the scanned modules and store presets of knob settings and cable connections displayed as simple schematics. Includes a cable physics engine, with the goal of running on an iPad as a reference to accompany live performances.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building an application for documenting modular patches, mostly for my own use case. It uses ML to recognise the patch points, knobs and toggles from a photo of the front panel. You can then build racks from the scanned modules and then store presets of the knobs and connections which are displayed as simple schematics.
